comment: This program's own native-image metadata: only what it reads and no library of the stack does. The libraries carry
their own (Win32, tactroller, DXGI, the pseudoconsole, the shaders, the standard font atlas) with their FFM flags,
and the processor writes the icon's, so none of that is here.
This editor's own fonts (the <families> baked into dev/vexelray/demo/editor/fonts/) are not the library's, so they are listed below.
The title bar's wordmark, /wordmark.sdgb (Wordmark), is read by name, so it is listed too.
Syntax highlighting: the grammars/ and every jcodings tables/*.bin -core brings (a trace lists only the tables one run
loaded), and two methods for TM4E. These move to the text-highlighting starter when it exists; until then they are
here, since without them a native build highlights nothing.
TM4E deep-copies a grammar through ObjectCloner, which finds each Raw* map's and list's clone() by Class.getMethod
and, when that finds nothing, copies into a plain HashMap or ArrayList, so the grammar is no longer an IRawGrammar.
Raw* inherit that public clone() from java.util.HashMap and ArrayList, so registering those two methods is enough.
Never register the Raw* classes themselves: TM4E's jar is signed, and that drags its X509 certificates into the image heap, which fails the build.
Add to it when a native run of this program fails on something the JVM run did not: run it on a JVM
